title: GPT-6 Astra Characterizes Exact Storage–Repair-Bandwidth Tradeoffs for (6,5,5) and (7,6,6) Regenerating Codes
aiSystem: GPT-6 Astra + Entropy-LP Integer Certifier (Texas A&M)
whyItMatters: GPT-6 Astra discovered new conditioning arguments and entropy-LP outer bounds with exact integer certificates, completely characterizing optimal storage-repair tradeoffs for (6,5,5) and (7,6,6) regenerating codes.
summary: On October 20, 2026, Chao Tian (Texas A&M University) published arXiv:2610.28199 completely characterizing the exact information-theoretic storage–repair-bandwidth tradeoff regions for exact-repair regenerating codes at parameters (n,k,d) = (6,5,5) and (7,6,6), proving that the layered codes of Tian et al. are strictly optimal. Determining exact tradeoff regions for regenerating codes beyond tiny parameter regimes has long defeated direct Shannon-type linear programs due to combinatorial explosion. GPT-6 Astra assisted in discovering both a new conditioning reduction and a structured search over restricted subsets of entropy linear-program constraints, yielding exact integer-valued proof certificates bundled with an independent Python verifier for machine checking.
technicalHighlights: Establishes exact information-theoretic outer bounds completely determining the storage–repair-bandwidth regions for (6,5,5) and (7,6,6) exact-repair regenerating codes.
Proves optimality of Tian et al.’s layered regenerating codes in both parameter regimes, extending exact distributed-storage limits beyond prior tractable cases.
GPT-6 Astra discovered a new conditioning argument and structured entropy-LP search, producing exact integer-valued proof certificates checked by a bundled Python verifier.
caveats: Preprint under active review; certificates are checked via exact integer arithmetic in Python rather than a kernel-verified proof assistant like Lean 4.

scoreRationale.foundational: Resolves exact fundamental information-theoretic limits for two longstanding open parameter regimes of distributed storage regenerating codes.
scoreRationale.ripple: Demonstrates a general AI-guided conditioning and restricted entropy-LP workflow applicable to network coding and multi-user information theory.
scoreRationale.verification: Accompanied by exact integer-valued proof certificates and an executable Python verifier eliminating floating-point LP ambiguity.
scoreRationale.velocity: Overcame decades of combinatorial entropy-LP intractability via AI-discovered conditioning reductions.
